state_definitions.conditional: promised maximum BEFORE effort; no earned personal currency yet
state_definitions.U: independently confirmed earned claim not yet posted; survives F rollover
state_definitions.F: operating authorization; full maximum scenario Fgranted=confirmed; no unissued expiry. U shown also in Fclose as earmarked authorization, not second liability
state_definitions.request: C held in personal account/order escrow until actual receipt; not redeemed at request
state_definitions.receipt: actual fulfillment reduces C; failed fulfillment remains order queue
state_definitions.reserve: all post-start unspent rights + U +ALL queued orders conservatively, minus paid stock once; original unrequested legacy exposure separately persists
state_definitions.conditional_prefunding: Month-close ordinary5.4mR does not prove before-effort coverage: fromm4 ordinary gross7.2mR+special0.2mR before prior quality finalday24. Paid/received/available singly allocated appropriate stock bybefore14th or verified separate cash backing; see dated_prefunding and independent date-prefunding.csv. Monthly CSV unchanged.
state_definitions.special: 200k finite contest/month; funding forecast available before independent acceptance; full scenario all slots earned, no invented pre-announcement result

launch_gate: Readiness assumption: existing-shop m0 order received/paid m1. EMPTY_SHOP stress removes incoming supply and creates retained queue; not base case. Additionally before14th verify paid/received/available singly allocated suitable batch (or separately verified liquid cash) against ordinary7.2mR+special0.2mR peak before prior quality closes24th. Monthly/yearly pass is not daily delivery evidence; existing rights cannot be delayed or cancelled.

dated_prefunding.classification: Conditional design readiness requirement; actual bank supply/payment/allocation timing unknown. No change to recognition rules or24mR annual policy.
dated_prefunding.paid_received_available_allocated_deadli: Before14th, before any new promise or effort on15th. Forecast appropriate batch must be paid, received, available and earmarked once; unpaid/unreceived or already-allocated inventory is not backing.
dated_prefunding.stock_credit: Credit eligible paid available stock exactly once: earned/requested rights first, then conditional promises. Gross peak is additional to earned/requested exposure; do not replace it with month-close5.4mR.
dated_prefunding.cash_fallback: If supply is delayed, separately verify liquid cash backing for all preserved rights and gross peak minus only eligible already-paid available singly allocated stock BEFORE a new promise. Without coverage do not start new promises; preserve all previously announced conditions, earned/U rights, posting dates and orders; no delay for savings.
dated_prefunding.resolution_limit: first-launch.csv is monthly and unchanged, not daily proof. Annual budget pass is conditional and is not evidence that a supplier actually delivered by14th.
